summary: Frontend-only test of inscricao.html fix for the disabled 'Inscrever' button. Verified: (1) with all fields filled but without document uploads, btn-inscrever stays disabled AND #missing-hint is visible in red listing 'Documento (frente), Documento (verso)'; (2) after uploading both #ins_doc_frente and #ins_doc_verso, btn-inscrever becomes enabled and #missing-hint hides (display:none); (3) Certame/Cargo selects work — switching to edital 03 repopulates cargoSel with '301 - GUARDA CIVIL MUNICIPAL' and #cargo-info shows Cargo, Período de Inscrição (27/07/26 09:00 - 25/08/26 16:00), Data da Prova (20/09/2026 09:15:00), Valor (R$ 90,00); (4) #cidadeProva has only 'PARACATU/MG' option preselected.
critical_code_review_comments: inscricao.html is 1467+ lines with multiple inline scripts/styles; consider splitting validation logic into a separate JS module for maintainability.
window.__isFormValid is defined twice (line ~885 and override ~1082 via monkey-patching origValid); this pattern works but is fragile — a single validation function would be clearer.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 temporary 1x1 PNG files in /tmp for doc frente/verso upload testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The fix for the 'Inscrever button not enabling' issue is working. The missing-hint red banner correctly informs users about missing document uploads. All 4 requested test scenarios passed.
